papers.title: Mechanical strain promotes osteogenic differentiation of mesenchymal stem cells on TiO
papers.abstract: Previous studies demonstrated cycle mechanical strain induced osteogenic differentiation of MSCs. But in general, MSCs are typically seeded on a flexible membrane or within a soft matrix. TiO2 nanotubes substrate topography plays a critical role in promoting the MSCs response and affects MSCs fate. Titanium implants surface modified by TiO2 nanotubes topography provides the opportunity to improve osseointegration by additionally regulating the MSCs fate. Titanium is one of most commonly used materials in the orthopedics and can undergo elastic deformation under certain mechanical stress. Therefore, for clinic trails, it is necessary to investigate the effect of mechanical strain on osteogenesis of MSCs on TiO2 nanotubes modified titanium substrate. But until now, there has been no research focused on the relationship between mechanical strain and osteogenesis of MSCs on the TiO2 nanotubes topography substrate. Here, we firstly applied the mechanical stress to the TiO2 nanotubes modified titanium specimen to investigate the effects of mechanical strain on the biological behaviors of MSCs. Our present study showed that mechanical strain promoted cell proliferation, spreading and increased vinculin expression of MSCs on the TiO2 nanotubes substrate. Additionally, mechanical strain enhanced the ALP activity and osteogenesis genes expression such as Runx2, BSP, ALP, OPN and OCN. Our results preliminarily demonstrated that mechanical strain enhanced the osteogenic differentiation of MSCs through the FAK-Erk1/2-Runx2 pathway on the TiO2 nanotubes substrate.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究机械应变对二氧化钛纳米管钛基体上MSCs成骨分化的影响
summary_zh.method: 在TiO2纳米管钛片上施加循环机械应变，检测细胞增殖、黏附及成骨基因表达
summary_zh.result: 机械应变通过FAK-Erk1/2-Runx2通路促进MSCs增殖、铺展及成骨分化
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验验证成骨相关基因和蛋白表达

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of mechanical strain on osteogenic differentiation of MSCs cultured on TiO2 nanotube-modified titanium substrates.
summary_en.method: Cyclic mechanical strain was applied to TiO2 nanotube-coated titanium specimens, and cell proliferation, spreading, vinculin expression, ALP activity, and osteogenic gene expression were assessed.
summary_en.result: Mechanical strain promoted MSCs proliferation, spreading, and osteogenic differentiation via the FAK-Erk1/2-Runx2 signaling pathway.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture experiments with gene and protein expression analyses.

papers.title: Enhanced corrosion resistance of zinc-containing nanowires-modified titanium surface under exposure to oxidizing microenvironment.
papers.abstract: Titanium (Ti) and its alloys as bio-implants have excellent biocompatibilities and osteogenic properties after modification of chemical composition and topography via various methods. The corrosion resistance of these modified materials is of great importance for changing oral system, while few researches have reported this point. Recently, oxidative corrosion induced by cellular metabolites has been well concerned. In this study, we explored the corrosion behaviors of four common materials (commercially pure Ti, cp-Ti; Sandblasting and acid etching-modified Ti, Ti-SLA; nanowires-modified Ti, Ti-NW; and zinc-containing nanowires-modified Ti, Ti-NW-Zn) with excellent biocompatibilities and osteogenic capacities under the macrophages induced-oxidizing microenvironment. The results showed that the materials immersed into a high oxidizing environment were more vulnerable to corrode. Meanwhile, different surfaces also showed various corrosion susceptibilities under oxidizing condition. Samples embed with zinc element exhibited more excellent corrosion resistance compared with other three surfaces exposure to excessive H2O2. Besides, we found that zinc-decorated Ti surfaces inhibited the adhesion and proliferation of macrophages on its surface and induced the M2 states of macrophages to better healing and tissue reconstruction. Most importantly, zinc-decorated Ti surfaces markedly increased the expressions of antioxidant enzyme relative genes in macrophages. It improved the oxidation microenvironment around the materials and further protected their properties. In summary, our results demonstrated that Ti-NW-Zn surfaces not only provided excellent corrosion resistance properties, but also inhibited the adhesion of macrophages. These aspects were necessary for maintaining osseointegration capacity and enhancing the corrosion resistance of Ti in numerous medical applications, particularly in dentistry.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文关注钛表面改性而非增材制造，与AM生物医学方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no porous structure for stiffness matching, no as-built surface morphology analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究氧化微环境下改性钛表面的耐腐蚀性差异。
summary_zh.method: 制备四种钛表面（纯钛、SLA、纳米线、含锌纳米线）并测试其腐蚀行为。
summary_zh.result: 含锌纳米线表面在过氧化氢环境中耐腐蚀性最优，且抑制巨噬细胞粘附。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞培养和电化学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the corrosion behavior of different titanium surface modifications under oxidizing conditions mimicking inflammatory microenvironments.
summary_en.method: Fabricated four titanium surfaces (cp-Ti, Ti-SLA, Ti-NW, Ti-NW-Zn) and evaluated their corrosion resistance and macrophage response in H2O2-rich environments.
summary_en.result: Zinc-containing nanowire surfaces exhibited superior corrosion resistance and reduced macrophage adhesion, while promoting M2 polarization and antioxidant enzyme expression.
summary_en.validation: In vitro electrochemical corrosion tests and macrophage cell culture assays.
